title: Record M0 and M0.5 completion status in PLAN.md and README
requirements: In PLAN.md §10 Roadmap add an explicit status marker line directly under the M0 — Skeleton and M0.5 — Self-Hosting headings, in the form '**Status:** done — <evidence>' or '**Status:** partial — <what remains>', with concrete evidence references (make demo, telegram gateway, planner, task QA, peak policy, sandbox).
Do not delete or renumber existing roadmap items; only add status markers and, where a stated deliverable is missing, list it under 'partial' with the remaining item.
In README.md update the '**Status:** pre-alpha' section to name M0 and M0.5 as complete (or partial with the same wording as PLAN.md) and link to PLAN.md §10.
Keep the wording in English (D-025) and factual: do not claim a state that the repository does not show.
acceptance: The repository documentation claims only evidence that exists in the tree (make demo target, telegram module, planner module, task QA, peak policy, sandbox); a human confirms each claim is backed by a file or Makefile target.
constraints: Documentation-only change plus one test file; do not change product code.
Do not mention internal working documents or sessions in the text.
plan_goal: Довести проект до выхода на M1 (публичная OSS-альфа): вертикальный срез Django/DRF + React SPA + Postgres + S3 на Yandex Cloud, multi-repo, независимый e2e QA в изолированном стенде, staging с подтверждением человеком, учёт стоимости и приёмок, самохостинг Forgel на самом себе. Первой задачей — проставить в PLAN.md и README отметки о том, что из M0/M0.5 уже сделано, чтобы список отражал реальность.

result.summary: Recorded M0 and M0.5 completion status. PLAN.md §10 now carries a '**Status:** done — <evidence>' line directly under '### M0 — Skeleton (2–3 weeks)' citing concrete artifacts (Makefile/make demo, src/forgel/cli.py, orchestrator.py, ledger.py, telegram.py, approvals.py, registry/recipes.json, jurisdiction/generic.json and ru.json, Dockerfile + compose.yaml + hello-web template, context.py + forgel.toml, LICENSE/CONTRIBUTING.md), and a '**Status:** partial — <what remains>' line directly under '### M0.5 — Self-Hosting (immediate goal)' citing the existing telegram gateway, planner, task QA, task review, peak policy, sandbox, adoption, GitHub provider and deploy utility, and naming the remaining items (the self-hosting exit criterion and post-merge smoke with auto-revert). No existing roadmap item was deleted or renumbered; later milestones are untouched. README.md's '**Status:** pre-alpha' section now names M0 (done) and M0.5 (partial with the same remaining-work wording) and links to PLAN.md §10 (PLAN.md#10-roadmap). No executable test was added: documentation is verified by human review.
assumptions: Marked M0 as done: every M0 deliverable has a backing file or Makefile target in the tree.

Marked M0.5 as partial rather than done because its exit criterion (a real Forgel change accepted through Forgel itself) has not happened and post-merge smoke/auto-revert is still a reserved config field, both stated in README and PLAN §11.
Listed the missing M0.5 deliverables in the status line instead of adding new roadmap bullets, so existing items are neither deleted nor renumbered.
Used the exact existing M0/M0.5 headings (including the durations in parentheses) as the anchors for the status lines and the test lookups.
Kept the documentation in English per D-025 and wrote no internal-work references.
